notes.title: Dev Blog #1
notes.content:
[p]Hey friends! 

It’s time for a fresh progress update from [b][i]7th Floor[/i][/b]! We’ve been polishing core systems, finalizing level designs, and improving animations in preparation for the full game release! 

Estimated game release: Q4 2025[/p][p][/p][h2]✅ [b]What’s been done:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Finished the [b]level design[/b] for [i]all[/i] areas in the game[/p][/*][*][p]Finalized all [b]puzzles[/b] and their logic[/p][/*][*][p]Completed [b]enemy and boss AI[/b] behavior systems[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented all [b]weapons[/b] and their animations[/p][/*][*][p]Finalized the full [b]voice script[/b] for the voice actors[/p][/*][*][p]Polished core systems based on [b]demo[/b] [b]feedback[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Reworking the Demo[/b] with updated systems and visuals before the full release[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🎯 [b]What’s next:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Finalizing all [b]cutscenes[/b] and story sequences[/p][/*][*][p]Implementing [b]voice acting[/b] and additional [b]sound effects[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Adding [b]localization[/b] for supported languages[/p][/*][*][p]Extensive [b]testing[/b], [b]bug fixing[/b], and [b]optimization[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Want to stay connected and share your thoughts?[/h2][p][/p][p]🐦 Twitter/X: [url="https://x.com/InfoGraphicTour"]https://x.com/InfoGraphicTour[/url][/p][p]💬 Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/Jam4swwEg9"]https://discord.com/invite/Jam4swwEg9[/url]
[/p][p][b][i]7th Floor[/i][/b] is a true passion project for us. We work on it every single day after our regular jobs to bring you the best experience we can. Your support means everything, and we’re doing our best to deliver a haunting, immersive horror story as soon as possible.
[/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey![/p]
